items.item: The page has breadcrumbs back to the suppliers list, and the header shows the supplier name untruncated, a supplier code, a status lozenge with a text label, and up to four key fields
items.evidence: nav[aria-label='Breadcrumb'] has Suppliers / Northbridge Components Ltd.; h1 shows full untruncated name; SUP-10248 code; Active lozenge with text; four fields: 'Electronic components', '4.6 rating', 'Preferred vendor', 'Net 30 terms'.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Create purchase order") with other actions such as edit or deactivate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Primary button bg-blue-700 'Create purchase order'; secondary outlined 'Edit' button; overflow menu (#moreMenu) contains 'Export supplier record', 'Suspend supplier', 'Deactivate supplier'. Audit confirms headerPrimaryActions:1.

items.item: Sections (overview, contacts, purchase orders, documents, performance) are reachable through tabs or an anchor bar, with the first section loaded by default and the active one marked for assistive technology
items.evidence: nav[aria-label='Tabs'] with 5 tab-btn buttons toggles panel visibility via JS and loads 'overview' panel by default, but the nav lacks role="tablist"/role="tab" and the script (tabBtns.forEach -> classList.toggle) only swaps border/text colour classes, never setting aria-selected or aria-current, so the active tab is not programmatically marked for assistive technology.

items.item: Company details are shown as label–value pairs in a read-only layout, with empty values handled consistently and never shown as "N/A", and email and phone shown as links with the primary contact marked
items.evidence: dl/dt/dd pairs under 'Company information' (Legal name, Tax ID, Registered address, Website, Payment terms, Currency, Category, Supplier since) are plain text, not inputs; empty expiry values elsewhere use '—' not 'N/A'; ... and ... links; 'Primary' badge on Elena Marchetti contact card.

items.item: The purchase orders list shows PO number, absolute date, status and a right-aligned total with currency, uses tabular figures, and links each PO number to its record
items.evidence: Row: PO-20512, '02/11/2026' absolute date, status badge 'Pending', £24,850.00 header 'Total (GBP)' right-aligned, tabular-nums class applied to all date/amount cells.

items.item: Each certificate or document shows its expiry date and a status that combines colour with a text label ("Valid", "Expiring in 30 days", "Expired"), and expired or expiring items are visually surfaced first
items.evidence: Rows show expiry dates and coloured text-label badges ('On file' grey, 'Expires in 36 days' amber, 'Expired' red), but table order is Supplier quality agreement (On file) → ISO 9001:2015 (Expires in 36 days) → RoHS certificate (Expired) → W-9 (On file) — the expired item is 3rd and the expiring item is 2nd, not surfaced first.

items.item: Performance metrics (such as on-time delivery rate and quality or defect rate) state their measurement period and unit, and show a signed change against the previous period without relying on colour alone
items.evidence: Cards show '94%' On-time delivery with '+3 pts vs last quarter', '98.2%' Quality acceptance rate with '+0.6 pts vs last quarter', '12 days' Average lead time with '+1 day vs last quarter', 'YTD spend £186,420' with 'vs £201,050 last year' — units (%, days, £) present and explicit '+' sign text conveys direction independent of the green/red colour.

items.item: Each section has its own empty state with a useful next action (for example "Add contact", "Upload certificate") and a loading skeleton; a failed section shows an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No empty-state markup, no skeleton/placeholder elements (audit env.loadingPlaceholders: 0), and no error/retry UI exists anywhere in the HTML or script; all panels only render populated static data.

items.item: Deactivating the supplier or deleting a document asks for confirmation naming the supplier or file and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: 'Deactivate supplier' is a plain Deactivate supplier link inside #moreMenu with no click handler or confirmation modal in the

) is an initials tile standing in for a company logo, not a person. decorative-chart: the Performance tab's 'On-time delivery, last 6 months' chart is built from plain divs with inline height percentages and no data labels/tooltips, functioning as a static decorative bar chart rather than a real chart component. Audit flags 4 text-contrast violations (tab counters and the NB avatar) at ~2.45:1–4.34:1 against the 4.5:1 requirement.
